description: Two bunkers on the Ironwood build list (a structure with a TransportContain for 4 infantry whose passengers may fire out; no weapon of its own), a build button for them in the worker's command set, a transport slot for the infantry. The computer players build them (the skirmish build code builds the build list entries of the power kind by itself; the bunker is of that kind and of the defence kind). For the standing garrisons (bunker).

edits.append:
; Bench overlay: a bunker: a structure with a container for 4 infantry whose passengers may fire out; it has no weapon of its own.
; (KindOf FS_POWER is how the skirmish build code picks it up by itself: it builds the entries of the power kind of the build list.)
Object IronwoodBunker
  Buildable = Yes
  Scale = 0.7
  Side = Ironwood
  EditorSorting = STRUCTURE
  DisplayName = OBJECT:IronwoodPowerPlant
  Draw = W3DModelDraw ModuleTag_Draw
    OkToChangeModelColor = Yes
    DefaultConditionState
      Model = iw_power
    End
  End
  KindOf = STRUCTURE SELECTABLE IMMOBILE FS_BASE_DEFENSE FS_POWER SCORE CAN_SEE_THROUGH_STRUCTURE
  Body = StructureBody ModuleTag_Body
    MaxHealth = 700.0
    InitialHealth = 700.0
  End
  ArmorSet
    Conditions = None
    Armor = IronwoodStructureArmor
    DamageFX = None
  End
  Behavior = TransportContain ModuleTag_Contain
    Slots = 4
    PassengersAllowedToFire = Yes
    AllowInsideKindOf = INFANTRY
    ExitDelay = 100
    NumberOfExitPaths = 1
    DamagePercentToUnits = 0%
    GoAggressiveOnExit = Yes
  End
  Behavior = DestroyDie ModuleTag_Destroy
  End
  Behavior = FXListDie ModuleTag_DeathFX
    DeathFX = FX_StarterBuildingDie
  End
  Prerequisites
    Object = IronwoodPowerPlant
  End
  BuildCost = 300
  BuildTime = 8.0
  VisionRange = 220.0
  ShroudClearingRange = 260.0
  RadarPriority = STRUCTURE
  Geometry = CYLINDER
  GeometryMajorRadius = 16.0
  GeometryMinorRadius = 16.0
  GeometryHeight = 20.0
  GeometryIsSmall = No
End

; Bench overlay: the worker can build the bunker.
CommandButton Command_ConstructIronwoodBunker
  Command = DOZER_CONSTRUCT
  Object = IronwoodBunker
  TextLabel = CONTROLBAR:ConstructIronwoodBarracks
  ButtonImage = SP_Barracks
  ButtonBorderType = BUILD
  DescriptLabel = CONTROLBAR:ToolTipConstructIronwoodBarracks
End

edits.find:
Structure IronwoodFactory
      Location = X:60 Y:-60
      Rebuilds = 3
      Angle = 0.0
      InitiallyBuilt = No
      AutomaticallyBuild = Yes
    End
edits.replace:
Structure IronwoodFactory
      Location = X:60 Y:-60
      Rebuilds = 3
      Angle = 0.0
      InitiallyBuilt = No
      AutomaticallyBuild = Yes
    End
    Structure IronwoodBunker
      Location = X:150 Y:0
      Rebuilds = 3
      Angle = 0.0
      InitiallyBuilt = No
      AutomaticallyBuild = Yes
    End
    Structure IronwoodBunker
      Location = X:0 Y:150
      Rebuilds = 3
      Angle = 0.0
      InitiallyBuilt = No
      AutomaticallyBuild = Yes
    End
